name: Uchiha Genin

entries.name: Sharingan Dodge
entries.text: As a reaction, add +2 to AC and Dex saves until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Hold Still
entries.text: When casting a Ninjutsu that requires an attack roll against a target who's moved less than 15 ft. this turn, make the attack at advantage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Can attack with Katana or Kunai. If using Kunai, can make an additional attack as a bonus action.

entries.name: Katana
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

notes: XP is not printed; 10 XP, as on every other Level 4 block. No DR is printed. Passive Perception is printed as 18 although the block lists no Perception skill and Wis +2 (which gives 12); kept as printed.

name: Akimichi Defender

entries.name: Protector
entries.text: Bonus action: mark an ally. They can't be knocked prone and have advantage on saves vs. physical conditions.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Makes one Shoulder Bash and one Arm Swing each turn.

entries.name: Shoulder Bash
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Arm Swing
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, 5 ft. radius. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

notes: The metadata line names no role; Defender is taken from the block's name. XP is not printed; 10 XP, as on every other Level 4 block. Passive Perception is printed as 3 although Wis -2 with no Perception skill gives 8; kept as printed.
